parts.type: Reader r a ⟶ Reader r (Reader r b)
parts.tooltip: fmap f :: Reader r a ⟶ Reader r (Reader r b)\nfmap f ma = \\r -> f (ma r)\nOnce r is supplied, the result is the next Reader — not yet run.

parts.type: Reader r (Reader r b) ⟶ Reader r b
parts.tooltip: join :: Reader r (Reader r b) ⟶ Reader r b — the Reader-specific part\njoin mm = \\r -> mm r r\nRun the outer Reader with r to get the inner Reader, then run it with the SAME env r. r is never modified.

ports.tooltip: Reader r a — a computation waiting for env r; when run with r it produces a
f : a ⟶ Reader r b — user code; given a, produces a new computation waiting for r
Reader r b — the composed computation; when run with r it produces b. Never Reader r (Reader r b).
